messages:
Amira (PM): Quick sync — we need to decide a long-term approach for tenant isolation + routing for next year's roadmap. Key asks from sales: per-tenant regional pinning, SLA slices, and stronger data residency guarantees. Can we sketch options and launch criteria?
Sangeeta (Staff Arch): +1. I think three parallel levers: 1) policy-as-code routing (policy engine), 2) topological isolation (dedicated slices / node pools), 3) soft isolation via throttles + evictions.
Dario (Eng): Agree. Important constraint: KV cache & batching semantics change with topology. If we do many tight slices, we lose cross-tenant batching which blows per-token cost. Need numbers.
Kevin (SRE): Also network/egress implications. Per-region pinning increases cross-region churn during failover. We need an evacuation playbook and bandwidth planning.
Amira (PM): Good flags. Can we produce a short pros/cons table for each lever? Also need explicit launch gates for customers and internal teams.
Sangeeta (Staff Arch): Quick sketch:
- Policy-as-code routing: Pros: flexible per-tenant rules, fast iterations. Cons: complex policy conflicts, requires robust telemetry.
- Topological isolation: Pros: strong isolation, predictable perf. Cons: cost + capacity fragmentation, longer lead times.
- Soft isolation (throttles/eviction): Pros: low-cost, fast rollout. Cons: weaker SLAs, harder to guarantee residency.
Dario (Eng): From runtime POV: policy-engine is easiest to roll out (sticky routing -> compatible model variants). Topology needs autoscaler changes and placement-aware batching.
migrate-bot: Migration note: created epic INF-PLAT-824 for "isolation pathways" and linked recent canary results.
Kevin (SRE): Launch gates suggestion:
- Observability: token-level latency and cross-region routing traces
- Ops runbook: automated evacuation steps + failure-mode tests
- Capacity: verified slice capacity + burst margins (50% headroom)
- Security: KMS integration validated for Private deployments
Amira (PM): Nice. Customer-facing acceptance criteria?
Sangeeta (Staff Arch): Keep it simple: 1) Route-level SLA docs, 2) Tenant-level residency guarantee (region tag + audit logs), 3) Failure modes documented and tested (RTO/RPO targets).
Dario (Eng): Also must include perf regression budget: max +10% p50 token latency vs baseline for pinned tenants, and unit-cost delta tracked.
Kevin (SRE): Add chaos tests for cross-region cutover + KV-cache warmup tests.
Amira (PM): Who can own the first draft of a rollout playbook (policy-engine first, topology later)? Target next Thurs.
Sangeeta (Staff Arch): I can own the playbook draft (policy-first).
Dario (Eng): I'll scope the runtime changes and quantify batching impact — ETA Tue.
Kevin (SRE): I'll draft ops runbook and failure tests — ETA Wed.
Amira (PM): Perfect. Action items: Sangeeta -> playbook, Dario -> batching/cost analysis, Kevin -> runbook/tests. We'll sync Fri for go/no-go on Q2 spike. React with :thumbsup: if you agree.
Dario (Eng): :thumbsup:
Kevin (SRE): :thumbsup:
Sangeeta (Staff Arch): :thumbsup:
Amira (PM): Thanks all — adding links and the INF-PLAT-824 epic to the roadmap doc.
